answer: A node pings each key eight times an epoch at secret hours, and a signed reply is due within ninety seconds. Seven of eight across three epochs hold standing. Fifty clones need fifty hosts awake all day, near $300 a month in rent, power and timber for the racks, unpaid until sixty drafts clear grading, plus fifty keys answering in the same 90-second window; two replies sharing one clock skew expose the batch. A miner keeping the node warm spends only a short wander offline. A pearl forms where an oyster sat through years of grit; fifty rented shells for a month give a trader none.
